The '''HSG-67 laser cannon''' was a type of [[Starship/Legends|starship]]-mounted [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]] that was used by [[XS stock light freighter/Legends|XS stock]] [[Ace's XS stock light freighter|light freighters]] during the [[Great Galactic War]], [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], and [[Galactic War]]. The HSG-67 was mounted atop the ship, which was produced by [[Soniver Arms]].
